info.title: Vero OMS REST API
info.description: REST API documentation for Vero OMS authentication, accounts, orders, history, market data, notifications, referral, diagnostics and static assets.

tags.description: In-app notifications and push token registration

tags.name: Referral
tags.description: Referral code, rebate and commission summary APIs

bearerAuth.description: Bearer JWT used for protected REST API requests.

sessionToken.name: X-Session-Token
sessionToken.description: Session token returned by authentication flows.

Flow.name: flow
Flow.description: Authentication flow id returned by the corresponding create flow endpoint.

Resolution.name: resolution
Resolution.description: Candle resolution in seconds. The app uses 60 for 1 minute and 86400 for daily.

Error.description: Error response. The app reads detail or message when available.

ErrorResponse.description: Error response. Frontend extracts error, message, detail, or plain text.

GenericObject.description: Untyped JSON object for dynamic response fields.

error.description: Machine-readable error code or short error string.

detail.description: Detailed error text returned by the backend when available.

details.description: Additional structured error details, if provided by the backend.

status.description: HTTP status code associated with the error.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error payload returned by the API.

tokenized.description: Bearer JWT returned when a tokenized session is requested.

password.description: Mobile app generates a secure random password.

qty.description: Positive is long, negative is short.

MarginRatio.description: Margin, fee, tax, and risk-ratio configuration.

amount.description: Withdrawal amount. Must be greater than zero.

bankId.description: Registered bank account identifier to receive the withdrawal.

WithdrawEquityRequest.description: Payload for withdrawing equity to a registered bank account.

bankAccountName.description: Beneficiary name on the bank account.

bankCode.description: Bank code selected by the user.

BankAccount.description: Bank account saved by the current user for withdrawals.

bankAccountName.description: Beneficiary name on the bank account.

CreateBankAccountRequest.description: Payload for creating a bank account.

orderStatus.description: FIX 5.0 style values used by the app: 0 New, 1 Partially Filled, 2 Filled, 4 Cancelled, 7 Stopped, 8 Rejected. Backend may also return text statuses.

transactionType.description: Examples used by UI: deposit, withdraw, fee, trading_fee, overnight_fee, realized_pnl, pnl, tax, trading_tax, commission, trading_commission, referral_refund, referral_rebate.

data.description: Notification payload with account, symbol, amount, or position details.

read.description: Whether the user has marked the notification as read.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

Notification.description: Notification record stored by the backend.

unixTime.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds, based on mobile app parsing.

RightSubscription.description: Right subscription rule or user subscription item.

shares.description: Number of new shares the user wants to subscribe for.

SubscribeRightRequest.description: Payload for user subscription to a right offering.

status.description: Status string returned by the backend.

StatusResponse.description: Generic status response for mutation endpoints.

accountId.description: Account whose covered margin value should be changed.

symbol.description: Symbol whose covered margin amount should be changed.

amount.description: New covered margin amount. Must be zero or greater.

AdjustCoveredMarginRequest.description: Payload for adjusting covered margin call amount for a symbol.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the response.

data.description: Wrapped response payload, or null when the request failed.

message.description: Success or error message returned with the response.

CustomResponse.description: Response wrapper containing status, data and message.

status.description: HTTP-like status code returned with the order response.

data.description: Order response payload, or null on failure.

status.description: HTTP status from the market-data request.

symbol.description: Symbol associated with the response when applicable.

data.description: Market-data payload returned by the backend.

status.description: Status string returned by the backend, usually success.

MessageResponse.description: Simple success response with an optional status and message.

refCode.description: Referral code owned by the current user.

referredCode.description: Referral code that referred the current user.

friendsWhoTraded.description: Number of referred users with trading activity.

totalRebatesGiven.description: Total rebates given to referred users.

ReferralSummary.description: Aggregated referral statistics for the current user.

ownerAccountId.description: Account that owns the referral code.

rebateRate.description: Rebate rate as a decimal between 0 and 1.

ReferralInfo.description: Referral code owner and rebate-rate information.

rebateRate.description: Rebate rate as a decimal between 0 and 1.

SetRefCodeRebateRateRequest.description: Payload for setting rebate rate on a referral code.

frontImage.description: Base64-encoded image content for the front side of the ID card. Send only the base64 payload, not the data URL prefix.

backImage.description: Optional base64-encoded image content for the back side of the ID card. Send only the base64 payload when the back image is available.

portraitImage.description: Optional base64-encoded portrait or selfie image captured during signup.

IdCardParseRequest.description: Request payload for submitting ID-card images during signup.

data.description: Parsed identity fields extracted from the submitted ID-card images.

imageUrls.description: Stored or normalized image URLs returned when available.

IdCardParseResponse.description: Successful response from the ID-card parsing API.

idNumber.description: ID-card or citizen identification number extracted from the document front image.

fullName.description: Full legal name extracted from the ID card.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth extracted from the ID card, in dd/MM/yyyy format when available.

sex.description: Sex value extracted from the ID card.

nationality.description: Nationality extracted from the ID card.

placeOfOrigin.description: Place of origin or hometown extracted from the ID card.

placeOfResidence.description: Registered place of residence extracted from the ID card.

dateOfExpiry.description: ID-card expiry date extracted from the document, in dd/MM/yyyy format when available.

dateOfIssue.description: Optional issue date extracted from the ID card.

issuedBy.description: Optional issuing authority extracted from the ID card.

address.description: Optional parsed address returned by the ID-card parser.

IdCardData.description: Parsed identity information returned by the ID-card parser.

front.description: URL of the stored or processed front-side ID-card image.

back.description: URL of the stored or processed back-side ID-card image.

portrait.description: URL of the stored or processed portrait or selfie image.

IdCardImageUrls.description: Image URLs returned by the ID-card parser after processing signup images.

device_id.description: Stable device/browser identifier used to update rotating tokens.

PushTokenRequest.description: Payload for registering or unregistering a device push token.
